name: Hyperscale SSD CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run Behave Tests on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]

    outputs:
      test_outcome: ${{ steps.run_behave_tests.outputs.test_outcome }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install behave-html-pretty-formatter jq

      - name: Run Behave Tests
        id: run_behave_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          OS_NAME=${{ matrix.os }}
          BUILD_NUMBER=${{ github.run_number }}
          REPORT_DIR="reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS_NAME"
          mkdir -p "$REPORT_DIR"

          behave --tags=@walking --exclude "features/manual_tests" \
            --format behave_html_pretty_formatter:PrettyHTMLFormatter \
            -o "$REPORT_DIR/validation_report.html" --no-capture | tee /tmp/behave_output.txt
          TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?

          if [ $TEST_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            if grep -q "failed" /tmp/behave_output.txt; then
              RESULT=UNSTABLE
            else
              RESULT=FAIL
            fi
          else
            RESULT=PASS
          fi
          echo "Detected result: $RESULT"
          echo "test_outcome=$RESULT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$RESULT" > "$REPORT_DIR/status.txt"
          echo "$(TZ='America/Los_Angeles' date)" > "$REPORT_DIR/timestamp.txt"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: reports/${{ github.run_number }}/${{ matrix.os }}/


  update-history:
    name: Update History and Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test]

    env:
      SITE_DIR: site

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download all reports
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: reports

      - name: Merge and generate build history
        run: |
          mkdir -p history
          mkdir -p $SITE_DIR
          HISTORY_JSON="history/history.json"
          BUILD_NUMBER=${{ github.run_number }}
          TIMESTAMP=$(TZ='America/Los_Angeles' date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S PDT")

          # Create JSON if missing
          if [ ! -f "$HISTORY_JSON" ]; then
            echo "[]" > "$HISTORY_JSON"
          fi

          # Detect per-OS results from downloaded artifacts
          UBUNTU_RESULT=$(cat reports/build-ubuntu-latest/status.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "UNKNOWN")
          WINDOWS_RESULT=$(cat reports/build-windows-latest/status.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "UNKNOWN")

          UBUNTU_LINK="reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/ubuntu-latest/validation_report.html"
          WINDOWS_LINK="reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/windows-latest/validation_report.html"

          jq --argjson build "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
             --arg timestamp "$TIMESTAMP" \
             --arg ur "$UBUNTU_RESULT" \
             --arg wr "$WINDOWS_RESULT" \
             --arg ul "$UBUNTU_LINK" \
             --arg wl "$WINDOWS_LINK" \
             '
             (map(select(.build == $build)) | length) as $exists |
             if $exists == 0 then
               . + [{build: $build, timestamp: $timestamp, results: {"ubuntu-latest": $ur, "windows-latest": $wr}, links: {"ubuntu": $ul, "windows": $wl}}]
             else
               map(if .build == $build then
                    .results["ubuntu-latest"] = $ur |
                    .results["windows-latest"] = $wr |
                    .timestamp = $timestamp |
                    .links = {"ubuntu": $ul, "windows": $wl}
                  else . end)
             end
             ' "$HISTORY_JSON" > tmp.json && mv tmp.json "$HISTORY_JSON"

          # Generate HTML dashboard
          python3 <<'EOF'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          f = Path("history/history.json")
          if not f.exists(): exit(0)
          
          # FIX: Use read_text() to get content as a string, then use json.loads()
          data = json.loads(f.read_text())
          
          data.sort(key=lambda x: x["build"], reverse=True)

          html = ["<html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD History</title>",
                  "<script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js'></script>",
                  "<style>body{font-family:Arial;margin:20px;background:#f7f9fc;}table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;}th,td{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;padding:8px;}</style></head><body>",
                  "<h1>&#x1f6e0; Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD Build History</h1>",
                  "<h2>&#x1f4ca; Latest Reports</h2><ul>"]

          latest = data[0]
          html.append(f"<li>Ubuntu: <a href='{latest['links']['ubuntu']}'>Report</a> ({latest['results'].get('ubuntu-latest','UNKNOWN')})</li>")
          html.append(f"<li>Windows: <a href='{latest['links']['windows']}'>Report</a> ({latest['results'].get('windows-latest','UNKNOWN')})</li>")
          html.append("</ul><h2>&#x1f36c; Build History</h2><table><tr><th>Build</th><th>Timestamp (PDT)</th><th>Ubuntu</th><th>Windows</th></tr>")

          counts = {"PASS":0,"FAIL":0,"UNSTABLE":0}
          for e in data:
              u = e["results"].get("ubuntu-latest","UNKNOWN")
              w = e["results"].get("windows-latest","UNKNOWN")
              for s in (u,w):
                  if s in counts: counts[s]+=1
              html.append(f"<tr><td>#{e['build']}</td><td>{e['timestamp']}</td><td>{u}</td><td>{w}</td></tr>")

          html.append("</table><h2>&#x1f4c8; Trend Chart</h2><canvas id='trendChart' height='120'></canvas><script>const ctx=document.getElementById('trendChart');new Chart(ctx,{type:'bar',data:{labels:['PASS','FAIL','UNSTABLE'],datasets:[{label:'Count',data:[%d,%d,%d],backgroundColor:['#28a745','#dc3545','#ffc107']}]}});</script>" % (counts['PASS'],counts['FAIL'],counts['UNSTABLE']))
          html.append("</body></html>")
          Path("history.html").write_text("\n".join(html))
          EOF

          cp -r reports history.html history $SITE_DIR/

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SITE_DIR }}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

      - name: Workflow summary with badges
        if: always()
        run: |
          PAGE_URL="${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}"
          echo "### &#x1f6a6; Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Ubuntu Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ubuntu-Latest-blue)](${PAGE_URL}/reports/${{ github.run_number }}/ubuntu-latest/validation_report.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Windows Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-Latest-blue)](${PAGE_URL}/reports/${{ github.run_number }}/windows-latest/validation_report.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![History](https://img.shields.io/badge/View-History-green)](${PAGE_URL}/history.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "**Build #${{ github.run_number }} Results:** Ubuntu=${{ needs.test.outputs.test_outcome }} / Windows=${{ needs.test.outputs.test_outcome }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
